bottom_line: New US tariffs on Chinese goods across technology and industrial sectors signal a structural shift in trade policy, not a negotiating tactic.
what_changed: US Trade Representative published final tariff schedule covering semiconductors, EVs, batteries, steel, and aluminum with rates of 25-100%.
why_it_matters: Affects global supply chains, reshoring economics, and procurement strategies for any firm with China-dependent inputs.
main_uncertainty: China's retaliatory measures have been announced but not fully implemented; scope of exemptions remains unclear.

scenarios.name: Managed decoupling
scenarios.description: Both sides accept higher tariffs as new baseline; trade re-routes through third countries.
